title: Grateful Dead Live at Stanley Theatre on 1972-09-26
lineage: SBD Reel> unknown dat gens> digital noise reduction> 3dat gens> za/248-41

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1972 Stanley Theater show with a smoking Truckin’ > The Other One run, soaring He's Gone and a 20‑minute Play In The Band.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as clean, well‑balanced and truly “soundboard” quality, delivering every guitar lick and vocal line with crystal clarity. Musically the night is described as one of the strongest of the 1972 run – varied setlists, a monster Truckin’ > Other One sequence, standout renditions of He's Gone, Baby Blue, Bird Song, Greatest Story Ever Told and an epic 20‑minute Play In The Band keep the energy soaring.

ai_rating.rationale: Over twenty enthusiastic 5‑star reviews highlight both superb soundboard recording and an exceptional performance; only one low rating appears but its comment is positive, yielding a very high overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clean mix, crisp guitars and vocals, no noticeable drop‑outs; reviewers repeatedly call it “deep, clean, soundboard”, “superb” and “great quality”.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Varied set list with a strong first set and an even hotter second set; seamless transitions especially in the Truckin' > Other One run and the extended Play In The Band jam.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for inventive, soaring guitar licks, a powerful solo on He's Gone, and an impromptu blues showcase after the 'doo‑wop' chorus; described as “smoking” and “great Jer”.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for tight interplay with Jerry, described as “musical telepathy” and a solid foundation throughout the jams.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals highlighted as “crushes” and “great SLOW vocal”; praised on The Other One and Baby Blue performances.
